create.name: Eileen Rose Miles
create.bio:
Eileen Rose Miles is an American meditation guide from Michigan who records gentle, voice-led meditations on self-compassion, rest and gratitude. She came to yoga and meditation as a young woman working through a painful relationship with her own body, and those practices became the place where she learned to turn inward with kindness. She trained first in a 200-hour yoga programme at The Space in Brighton, Michigan, then completed Ashley Turner's 300-hour training in yoga psychology, and is registered at the 500-hour level. After three years living on the road in a camper van with her husband and their dog, she settled back in northern Michigan.

Her central work now is The Intuitive Meditation Guide, a small online teacher training of twelve weeks that helps people find their own voice for leading meditation without leaning on scripts, including the practical side of recording and publishing. She also offers one-to-one sessions pairing meditation with journalling, records personalised meditations as gifts, and co-leads destination retreats with Sacred Sojourn. Her guided practices are free on Insight Timer, on her podcast The Inward Journey and on her YouTube channel.

courses.title: The Intuitive Meditation Guide: Online Meditation Teacher Training
courses.description: A twelve-week live online training for a group of about ten, with peer practice groups and one-to-one time with Eileen. Students learn to lead meditation from presence rather than scripts and to record and publish their own practices. The next group begins in March 2027.

courses.title: Sea, Sky + Soul: Greek Island Adventure + Wellness Retreat
courses.description: A six-day retreat on Crete that Eileen co-leads with Adam Boettger of Sacred Sojourn. Days combine meditation and yoga with time exploring the island.

courses.title: 1:1 Meditation and Journal Experience
courses.description: A live hour with Eileen combining a guided meditation with journalling prompts and conversation about mindset. Offered as one session or a block of four.

courses.title: Personalized Guided Meditation
courses.description: Eileen records a meditation of around twenty minutes written for one named person, from details the buyer gives her. Often bought as a gift.

courses.title: Overcome Technology for Quality Audio Course
courses.description: A self-paced set of more than twenty video lessons for meditation teachers on choosing a microphone, editing in free software and preparing tracks for upload. Aimed at people who want to publish their own guided meditations.

free_resources.title: Eileen Rose Miles on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her Insight Timer profile, where she shares guided meditations on rest, self-kindness and gratitude. The tracks are free to play.

free_resources.title: The Inward Journey: Guided Meditations (podcast)
free_resources.description: Eileen's free podcast of guided meditations, also on Spotify. Episodes are short practices for slowing down and coming back to the breath.
